definitions: A portion of the total value or ownership in a company or asset that is specifically allocated to or derived from a VTA (Venture Capital Trust Agreement) or similar investment vehicle.
The individual unit of ownership or investment within a VTA structure, often representing a claim on future profits or equity.
examples: The investor acquired a VTA Share in the tech startup.
Each VTA Share entitles the holder to a percentage of the dividends.
The valuation of a VTA Share can fluctuate based on market performance.
